description:
A Unitree G1 humanoid robot wearing a clown wig became the center of attention at a tourist attraction in Xinjiang, China, after an unexpected moment during a live demonstration.

The robot was performing martial arts moves for visitors when it accidentally made contact with a child standing nearby. According to reports, the child did not suffer any serious injuries, but the incident has sparked discussions about safety measures during public robotics demonstrations.

As humanoid robots become increasingly common in entertainment, tourism, and public spaces, the incident has raised questions about balancing innovation with public safety.

Watch the full video to see what happened and join the conversation about the future of AI-powered robots in everyday life.
